Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

nycosm 0.0.1.9000

  • Initial release.

  • nyc_osm_points(), nyc_osm_lines(), nyc_osm_buildings(), nyc_osm_areas(), and nyc_osm_routes() give lazy access to OpenStreetMap features for New York City (Geofabrik extract of 2026-10-18), stored as GeoParquet in EPSG:2263, with full tags.

  • nyc_osm_path(), nyc_osm_to_sf(), and nyc_osm_add_tags() helpers.

Developed by Kieran Healy.

Site built with pkgdown 2.2.1.
